title: Asset check
caption: Day one: Marc (bat idle), Yola (pistol idle) and a walker, loaded from the compressed GLBs (43 MB of models down to 15 MB). No room, no UI, no weapons in hand yet.

title: Painted room: ER lobby
caption: Stage 1. The room painter builds a small 3D room from the hospital kit (desk, chairs, wheelchair, blood decals), renders it from the exact battle camera, then runs an oil-paint (Kuwahara) filter, canvas grain and a colour grade over it, so the backdrop reads as a painting.

title: Painted room: boss gate
caption: Stage 1. The boss room: elevator, barriers, red emergency light. Each of the 10 rooms has its own palette and dressing.

title: Painted room: pharmacy (shop)
caption: Stage 1. The shop backdrop: medicine shelves, counter, green light.

title: Battle stage: first fight
caption: Stage 1. The 3D stage on the painted ward: Marc at the melee spot with his bat in hand, Yola behind with her pistol, zombies in their slots, contact shadows, the director playing a scripted fight.

title: Battle stage: the Shield Guard
caption: Stage 1. The boss cast: the Shield Guard with his procedural riot shield.

title: Combat HUD on the real engine
caption: Stage 1. The card UI driving the real combat engine (no 3D yet): the hand, energy orb, piles, End Turn, intents and HP bars over stand-in silhouettes.

title: Title screen
caption: Stage 1. The title screen on the painted ER backdrop (the live 3D heroes join it at integration).

title: Hospital floor-plan map
caption: Stage 1. The act map as a hospital blueprint: fights, elites, supply closets, pharmacy, locked rooms, treasure, the boss elevator at the top.

title: Pharmacy screen
caption: Stage 1. The shop: cards, relics, potions, card removal.

title: Armory (weapon unlocks)
caption: Stage 1. Weapons are the meta artifact system: scrap from every run unlocks bats, a crowbar, an axe, a sledgehammer, a shotgun and a sawed-off; each changes a passive and swaps starter cards.

title: Title: live 3D heroes
caption: Stage 2 (integration, work in progress). The real title screen: Marc and Yola as live 3D models idling in the painted ER, the menu on the right.

title: A run begins: the lobby
caption: Stage 2. A new run starts at the Lobby on the blueprint map; the first row is always fights.

title: First real fight: aiming
caption: Stage 2. Everything wired together: the painted ward, the 3D cast, the hand from the real engine. Dragging Clean Shot draws the targeting arrow to the Screamer and its HP bar previews the hit.

title: Zombies' turn
caption: Stage 2. End Turn hands over to the zombies: the banner, the energy orb empties, the Screamer already down to 41/54 from Marc and Yola's hits.

title: Supply closet (rest)
caption: Stage 2. A rest site reached by the autoplay bot: Rest (heal 24) or Patch Up (upgrade a card).

title: Supply crate (treasure)
caption: Stage 2. The treasure row: tap the crate to open it.

title: Pharmacy, live
caption: Stage 2. The shop inside the real run: card art rendered from the animation clips, 3D-rendered relic and medicine icons, a sale tag, card removal.

title: Locked room: Break Room
caption: Stage 2. An event with costs and rewards in green and red (story text is a placeholder for Marc).

title: Boss: the Shield Guard
caption: Stage 2. The boss fight at the security gate: 240 HP, riot shield, red emergency light.

title: Result screen (defeat)
caption: Stage 2. "You were overrun": the run summary and scrap banked for the Armory (a forced test loss, hence the zeros).

title: Title
caption: Stage 2 complete. The title over the live stage: Marc and Yola in the painted ER, the menu on the right.

title: Armory
caption: Stage 2 complete. The weapon racks: unlock with scrap, equip one weapon for each hero. The panel shows the passive and the starter-deck swap.

title: Shift Change
caption: Stage 2 complete. The run-start bonus: pick one of three.

title: Map
caption: Stage 2 complete. Level 1 as a blueprint floor plan, from the lobby up to the boss elevator.

title: Fight
caption: Stage 2 complete. The first fight of a run: the painted room, the 3D cast, the HUD and the hand.

title: Aiming a card
caption: Stage 2 complete. A card dragged onto a zombie: the arrow, the highlight and the slice of HP it would take.

title: Zombies' turn
caption: Stage 2 complete. The zombies' turn, frozen on the first hit landing on the party.

title: Finisher
caption: Stage 2 complete. A kill on a Staggered zombie: the slow-motion finisher.

title: Elite fight
caption: Stage 2 complete. An elite (Big Walker) in the harsher elite grade.

title: Boss fight
caption: Stage 2 complete. The Shield Guard at the security gate.

title: Rewards
caption: Stage 2 complete. The reward panel over the won fight: supplies, a potion maybe, and a card to add.

title: Card pick
caption: Stage 2 complete. Pick one of three cards, or skip.

title: Supply Closet
caption: Stage 2 complete. Rest (heal 30%) or Patch Up (upgrade a card).

title: Patch Up
caption: Stage 2 complete. The upgrade picker: hover shows the upgraded card.

title: Pharmacy
caption: Stage 2 complete. The shop: cards on the shelf, relics and medicine on the counter, card removal.

title: Locked room
caption: Stage 2 complete. A locked-room event with its choices (text is a placeholder).
